thread:
Alex: quick check — rolling kv-evict canary looks green overall but I just saw two p99 tokenization alerts from eu-west ~20m ago. anyone oncall to grab traces? :eyes:

Maria: I'm oncall. saw the alerts, jumping in. trace: https://traces.internal/trace/8f2a — batcher backlog spiked to ~1.2k, KV eviction loop kicked in multiple times.

Kevin: thanks @Maria. can you confirm whether the warm pool was draining? if so we should reroute to dedicated warm nodes for eu-west. command if needed: `./tool reroute --pool warm-eu-west --duration 15m`

OpsBot: ALERT: p99-inference-latency (eu-west) triggered 2x at 2026-03-17T09:12:20Z and 2026-03-17T09:31:05Z. Linked incident: INC-2026-71.

Sam: @Maria any correlation with the recent batching hotfix deploy? I recall a PR that changed the batch timeout default.

Priya: I rolled the batching hotfix earlier this morning (PR #1418). It lowered the max wait to 5ms to reduce tail latency, but might increase pressure on the batcher under thin traffic. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/1418 :memo:

Maria: confirmed: after the hotfix we saw more frequent small batches which spiked queue churn; KV eviction reclaimed memory but caused brief latency spikes when garbage-collecting. Suppressed the noisy alert for 10m while I test a quick throttle. No paging yet.

Alex: can you create a short ticket with steps to reproduce + current mitigations? I'll assign to eng-runtime and add SRE-owners. Ticket: SRE-4821.

Priya: added logs and a minimal repro in the ticket, noted the hotfix rollout window.

Kevin: for immediate mitigate, I'm +1 for temporary reroute to warm pool in eu-west and increase batcher capacity by +2 workers. will coordinate with infra to scale. ping me if you need the command. :thumbsup:

Maria: thanks team. scaling now, will monitor for 20m and post back. current blocker: validating that the leak isn't from a separate memory regressor — running `heap-scan --service batcher --duration 300s`.

Sam: thanks — let me know if you want me to shadow the runbook steps.

Maria: update 09:48 UTC — scale completed, p99s down to baseline, heap-scan shows no new alloc hotspots. keeping watch for 1h. closing the suppression. :white_check_mark:
